integrity: The proof is analytic. Exact symbolic and rational computations in verify.py are supplemental consistency checks and are not used as a substitute for the infinite induction.
limitations: Requires strictly positive mass on every positive integer and only proves the m=3 conjecture under local log-concavity at indices 2 and 3; it does not settle unrestricted m=3 or any m>3 case.
title: Local log-concavity forces geometricity in the three-record identity
